spans.s: सिंहृावलोकितन्याय the analogy of the backward look peculiar to a lion, who, as he advances, does always look back at the ground covered. The word is used in grammar ) with reference to a word taken back from a rule to the preceding rule which technically is called अपकर्षः cf. वक्ष्यमाणं विभाषाग्रहणमिह सिंहावलो- कितन्यायेन संबध्यते Kas. on
